content_fields.title: Validate certificate and its chain of trust properly
content_fields.description: Validate the server certificate and its chain explicitly on every outbound TLS call.
content_fields.finding: requests.get is called on a caller-supplied URL with no explicit certificate verification or CA bundle configuration.
content_fields.required_fix:
# app/apis/menu/utils.py
import certifi

session = requests.Session()
session.verify = certifi.where()      # explicit CA bundle, never False


def _fetch_image(image_url: str) -> bytes:
    response = session.get(image_url, timeout=5, allow_redirects=False)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.content
criteria: The CA bundle is pinned explicitly rather than inherited from the environment.
A connection to a host with an untrusted certificate fails.
